operations.name: read_ahci_version
operations.desc: Read AHCI version register from ABAR
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xFEBD0000
mov eax, [ebx + 0x10]
ret
operations.returns: AHCI version in EAX (high 16 = major, low 16 = minor)

operations.name: read_ahci_cap
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xFEBD0000
mov eax, [ebx + 0x00]
ret
operations.returns: Capabilities in EAX (bits 4:0 = num ports, bit 31 = 64-bit addressing)

operations.name: read_ahci_ports
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov ebx, 0xFEBD0000
mov eax, [ebx + 0x0C]
ret
operations.returns: Ports implemented bitmask in EAX (bit N = port N available)
